board.welcome.title: Welcome!
board.welcome.text: This is a library you share with others. Walk straight ahead through the glass doors, pick a chair at the long table and get to work next to everyone else.
board.events.title: This week
board.events.none: No events pinned this week yet. Talks, meetups and study marathons will show up here.
board.break.title: Need a break?
board.break.text: The smoking room on the left is the place to chat. Talk freely there, then come back to your seat.
board.people.title: Meet people
board.people.text: Tap someone to poke them, whisper or add them as a friend. Friends can message you on the 📱 phone in any room but the library.
board.rules.title: House rules
board.quiet.title: Quiet please
board.how.title: How studying works
board.how.1: Tap a free chair at one of the desks. You sit down facing the desk.
board.how.2: Choose what you work on. Everyone sees it on the table in front of you.
board.how.3: Add a timer if you like (25, 50 or 60 minutes), with “do not disturb” while it runs.
board.how.4: Standing up with a timer asks first. Leaving the library ends the timer.
board.sessions.title: Study sessions
board.sessions.none: No group sessions scheduled yet. Sit down any time; someone is usually studying.
rules.phone: Phones are on silent here. Messages wait until you leave.
coach.hall: Welcome! People study together in the library, straight ahead through the glass doors. Tap where you want to go, walk with WASD or the arrow keys, or use the stick on a phone. The reception desk explains the place.
coach.library: The glowing chairs are free: tap one to sit down and study. It is quiet here. The shelves, the paintings and the closed side are worth a closer look.
coach.smoking: This is the break room. Chat freely here, then head back to your seat in the library.
look.note: Every look has its own face, hair and clothes.
tip.reception: Reception · private rooms, and what this place is
notice.desk_opened: a new desk for two just opened in the library! 🌱
notice.no_dance: no dancing here. try the hall or the smoking room.
map.title: Map
chat.closed: Room chat is off in the library: this is a place to focus.
radial.title: Your actions
radial.message.off: The phone can't be used here
intro.title: What is Around the Table?
intro.lead: A place to study and to hang out where you are someone, not a few letters from an invisible stranger. You walk in as a character, study next to other people, build friendships by working side by side, and on your breaks the smoking room fills with friendly conversation.
intro.break.title: Take a break
intro.break.text: Head to the smoking room and enjoy the room chat. Talk freely and meet people.
intro.focus.title: Focus together
intro.focus.text: Go to the library, sit at a desk and get to work. Notice who is studying next to you.
intro.friends.title: Make friends
intro.friends.text: Poke someone, add them as a friend, send a message, and come back to study together.
intro.grow.title: Grow with us
intro.grow.text: The library opens a new desk each time it fills up. Look around: the shelves and paintings have stories.
board.grow.title: The library grows
board.grow.text: The rest of the library is being renovated. It grows carefully, the way a real place would: whenever more people come in than there are chairs, a new desk for two opens on the closed side, and it stays open.
board.grow.now: Right now: {count} seats at desks for two.
hint.touch: tap to walk · tap someone to say hi · tap yourself for actions · 🙂 for emotes
notice.pet_waits: Your cat can't come in here. We'll look after it until you're back. 🐾
look.extrasNote: Your pet walks with you everywhere but the library, where it waits at the door. Footsteps are only heard by you.
clock.open: The clock · open the event calendar 📅
calendar.title: Events
calendar.note: Times are shown in your own time zone. Anyone can propose an event; admins approve them.
event.thursday-meetup.title: Thursday Meetup
event.thursday-meetup.text: Every Thursday evening the smoking room fills up: string lights, a little music and whoever drops by. Come say hi, take a break from studying, meet the regulars.
notice.event_started: an event just started in the {name}! 🎉
plan.title: How will you study?
plan.pick: Pick a way to study from the ring. Nothing starts until you say yes.
plan.free.rhythm: Counts up from now; stop whenever you like.
plan.pomodoro.name: Pomodoro
plan.pomodoro.text: The classic: 25 minutes of focus, then a 5-minute break, four times. Short enough to start, long enough to get somewhere.
plan.deep.name: Deep focus
plan.deep.text: Two long blocks of 50 minutes with a 10-minute break between them, for work that needs you fully in it.
plan.marathon.name: Marathon
plan.marathon.text: One 90-minute block: as long as a mind stays sharp in one go. Bring water.
plan.custom.name: Your own
plan.custom.text: Set the focus, the break and how many rounds. It is remembered for next time.
plan.free.name: Stopwatch
plan.free.text: No goal, no bell: a stopwatch that counts how long you stayed. Good for reading.
plan.together.name: Together
plan.together.text: Join someone's focus block here and finish at the same moment. Studying alongside someone is easier.
plan.together.none: Nobody here is in a focus block right now. Start one, and others can join you.
timer.break.tip: Stretch, drink some water, or say hi in the smoking room.
timer.break.here: Good place for a break. Say hi to someone!
notice.vending: a hot coffee, on the house ☕

table.title: Table games
table.invite: Tell the room! Anyone here can sit down from the table.
table.darts.title: Darts
table.darts.short: 3 darts each · alone or with friends
table.darts.rules: Three darts each. The aim sways across the board: tap the board (or Throw) when it's where you want it. Bull is 50, the thin outer ring doubles, the inner ring triples. Highest total wins.
table.pig.title: Pig
table.pig.rules: On your turn, roll as often as you like and add up the dice. Roll a 1 and you lose this turn's points. Hold to bank them. First to 50 wins.
table.pig.bust: a 1! the turn's points are gone 🐷
table.guess.title: Higher or lower
table.guess.rules: The table thinks of a number from 1 to 100. Take turns guessing; after each try it says higher or lower. Whoever hits it wins.
jukebox.title: Jukebox
jukebox.empty: Calm piano, guitar and strings are playing. Paste a YouTube link to play a song for the room; the calm music comes back after.
jukebox.rules: Up to {n} songs each, played in turn for everyone here at the same quiet volume. Long mixes are welcome; a live stream plays until the room skips it.

confirm.block.text: You won't be able to message, poke or invite each other, and your friendship ends. {name} will be told they were blocked. You can unblock them later from the bell.

confirm.closeRoom.text: Everyone inside goes back to the hall and the room's code stops working. This can't be undone.

people.about: Muting hides someone's bubbles, messages and pokes on your screen only; they aren't told. Blocking stops messages, pokes and invites both ways and ends the friendship; they are told.
admin.title: Admins
admin.about: Admins approve events and can make others admins (from their profile card). The owner set on the server is always an admin.

discovery.lost.text: Many of our members left something behind: scarves, chargers, a favourite pen. If one of these is yours, it waits here for you.

exit.text: You step out to the character select. Your friends see you leave; you can come straight back in, or play as your other character.

lobby.text: Pick who walks in. Each character has their own name, look, goals and study time.
lobby.note: Up to {max} characters on this device. They live in this browser only.

lobby.delete.text: Their look, goals and the study time kept on this device are gone for good. This cannot be undone.
goals.title: Today's goals
goals.text: Set what you mean to do today. Focus time from the study timer fills the goal you are on; progress starts over tomorrow, the goals stay.
goals.full: That's {max} goals already: plenty for one day.
goals.error.empty: write what the goal is first.
quests.title: Quests
table.rps.title: Rock, paper, scissors
table.rps.short: pick in secret · best of 3 or 5
table.rps.rules: Everyone picks rock, paper or scissors in secret; the picks show together. Rock beats scissors, scissors beat paper, paper beats rock. With three or more, a round only counts when exactly two kinds of pick are on the table.
table.coin.title: Coin toss
table.coin.rules: On your turn call heads or tails, and the table flips. A right call is a point. First to three wins.
table.duel.title: Dice duel
table.duel.rules: Everyone rolls two dice at once. The highest total takes the round; a shared top roll counts for nobody. First to three wins.
table.ttt.title: Tic-tac-toe
table.ttt.rules: Three in a row, across, down or corner to corner, wins the board. A full board is played again. Who starts swaps after every board.
table.chain.title: Word chain
table.chain.short: last letter, next word · first to 8
table.chain.rules: Take turns saying a word that starts with the last letter of the one before. No word twice. Each good word is a point; first to eight wins. (In Turkish a word ending in ğ goes on with g.)
table.math.title: Quick math
table.math.short: first right answer scores · first to 5
table.math.rules: A sum appears for everyone at once. The first right answer scores, then a new one comes. They get harder as you go. First to five wins.
table.emoji.title: Emoji riddle
table.emoji.short: guess the word or film · first to 3
table.emoji.rules: A few emoji stand for a word or a film. Type your guess, in English or Turkish; the first right one scores. Nobody gets it? It is shown and a new one comes.

parlor.duel.first: everyone rolls, highest total takes it
